metrics.label: Trust
metrics.description: Mean respondent-level trust composite, retained on the original five-point agreement scale.

metrics.label: Intention to use
metrics.description: Mean response to the direct future-intention-to-use question. India has the highest country mean in this dataset.

metrics.label: Overall adoption intention
metrics.description: Mean across the four adoption-intention items: future use, use with access, everyday use, and purchase when available.

metrics.label: Trip-purpose intention
metrics.description: Mean across commute, business travel, errands, leisure, and vacation intention items.

metrics.label: Perceived safety
metrics.description: Mean agreement with “I would feel safe using the car.” This single item is included in the trust composite.

source.scale: 1-5 Likert means; missing and non-scale responses excluded
